title: Jono's Real Invisibility
description: Prevents hostile mobs from targeting invisible players. Works with potions, commands, and all invisibility effects.
body:
Keep yourself hidden from hostile mobs! This lightweight plugin makes invisible players completely safe:

Prevents targeting by all hostile mobs (zombies, skeletons, creepers, etc.).

Works with invisibility potions, commands, or any invisibility effect.

No commands or permissions required — just install and play.

Compatible with Paper 1.21.9.
